decision: Proposed: integrate HUSK (HTTP Universal Skill Kernel, https://github.com/elisymlabs/husk, MIT, TypeScript/Bun 1.3.11, HEAD 506a85c7ef39, npm @elisym/husk 0.2.1) into revvel-standards. Requirements set by Audrey: (1) no-delete rename policy: never delete existing files; disable by renaming (e.g. .py -> .py.disabled / .old) and write detailed before/after docs covering what was there, how it worked, and how it works now; (2) every change gets a very detailed ledger handoff entry usable by any bot, person, or LLM, proving integrity, authorship (created by Audrey), and the ups, downs, and failures, which together with WR/PR form the project's complete life story; (3) CHANGELOG.md and wr/memory/decisions.jsonl updated in the same commit, append-only; (4) deterministic, pinned deps (exact versions, lockfile, pinned Bun), code-only with no marketplace Actions (GitHub Actions locked by billing), runnable manually without bots; (5) GitLab/Gitee mirror readiness (plain files, no GitHub-only dependency). Safety note: HUSK loads bare SKILL.md as mode: llm with no default auth, so skills/ must not be served directly; serve only a curated run:-only folder on loopback. No renames or code changes made in this commit.
